item.title: Gulf Marine Services wins European contracts for liftboat pair
item.description: London-listed liftboat operator Gulf Marine Services (GMS) has won new contracts for two of its vessels. The contracts cover the use of two Large-class vessels in Europe. item.description: Offshore engineering and services player Subsea7 has won a deal from US exploration and production company LLOG Exploration for work on the Buckskin South Expansion project.
